fusions.name: Barbed Haul
fusions.desc: A barbed line that costs 4% of your maximum health, deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Raking Sweep
fusions.desc: Rakes a wide arc ahead of you with hooked steel, dealing 30 damage to everything caught in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: Barb Holds
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
